properties.description:
Triggered by a Meraki webhook when a device reports an unreachable alert. Parses the alert payload, then simultaneously collects contextual data from the Meraki API: configuration changes, device availability history, CDP/LLDP neighbor info, network events, and firmware upgrade status. All data is passed to an AI LLM (Cisco Circuit / GPT) for concise root cause analysis. A Python script formats results into a Webex Markdown message, delivered automatically via Webex API to a specified room.

**Key inputs:** Webhook JSON body, Webex Room ID, availability lookback (default 12h), config changes lookback (default 1200s).

**Integrations:** Cisco Meraki API · AI LLM · Webex APIs

properties.description:
**Cisco Meraki - Devices - Get Organization Devices**

List the devices in an organization that have been assigned to networks.

**Target:** A Meraki Endpoint using HTTPS "api.meraki.com" port 443 and no path.

**Account Key:** Meraki User API Key. API Key can be generated from Meraki Dashboard -> User Profile -> API Access.

Steps:
[] Sends Get Network request to Meraki
[] Check if the request was successful:
[]> If it was, attempt to extract the results and set the output variables
[]> If it wasn't, return the error and marks the workflow as failed.

NOTE: Empty attributes in the request are removed from the payload before sending to Meraki. 

More information about this API: https://developer.cisco.com/meraki/api-v1/get-organization-networks/

import json import sys # ------------------------------------------------------------------------- # 1. HELPER FUNCTIONS # ------------------------------------------------------------------------- def deep_json_parse(data): if isinstance(data, str): cleaned_str = data.strip() if (cleaned_str.startswith('{') and cleaned_str.endswith('}')) or \ (cleaned_str.startswith('[') and cleaned_str.endswith(']')): try: parsed = json.loads(cleaned_str) return deep_json_parse(parsed) except (ValueError, TypeError): return data return data elif isinstance(data, dict): return {k: deep_json_parse(v) for k, v in data.items()} elif isinstance(data, list): return [deep_json_parse(i) for i in data] return data def parse_json_input(raw_input, default_value, var_name="Unknown Variable", parsing_log=[]): if raw_input is None: return default_value if isinstance(raw_input, (list, dict)): return deep_json_parse(raw_input) if isinstance(raw_input, str): if not raw_input.strip() or raw_input == "Variable not found" or raw_input == "None": return default_value try: outer_data = json.loads(raw_input) return deep_json_parse(outer_data) except json.JSONDecodeError as e: error_msg = f"❌ {var_name} failed to parse.
Error: {e}" parsing_log.append(error_msg) return default_value return default_value def format_ts(ts_string): if not ts_string: return "" s = str(ts_string).replace('Z', '').replace('+0000', '').replace('T', ' ') return f"{s[:19]} UTC" def pretty_format_val(val): if isinstance(val, (dict, list)): return json.dumps(val, indent=2) return str(val) # ------------------------------------------------------------------------- # 2. EXTRACT ORDERED ARGUMENTS (sys.argv) # ------------------------------------------------------------------------- parsing_log = [] raw_alert_input = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else None raw_cl_str = sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else None raw_cdp_str = sys.argv[3] if len(sys.argv) > 3 else None raw_avail_str = sys.argv[4] if len(sys.argv) > 4 else None raw_events_str = sys.argv[5] if len(sys.argv) > 5 else None ai_summary_raw = sys.argv[6] if len(sys.argv) > 6 else None alert_data = parse_json_input(raw_alert_input, {}, "Alert Data", parsing_log) cl_data = parse_json_input(raw_cl_str, [], "Changelog", parsing_log) cdp_data = parse_json_input(raw_cdp_str, {}, "CDP Data", parsing_log) avail_data = parse_json_input(raw_avail_str, [], "Availability Data", parsing_log) events_data = parse_json_input(raw_events_str, [], "Events Data", parsing_log) # ------------------------------------------------------------------------- # 3. ANALYZE STATUS & COMPOSE EMAIL SUBJECT # ------------------------------------------------------------------------- inner_alert_details = alert_data.get('alertData', {}) resolved_ts_raw = inner_alert_details.get('resolved_at') is_resolved = True if resolved_ts_raw else False a_type = alert_data.get('alertType', 'Alert') a_dev = alert_data.get('deviceName', 'Unknown Device') a_net = alert_data.get('networkName', 'Unknown Network') if is_resolved: email_subject = f"✅ [RESOLVED] {a_type} - {a_dev} ({a_net})" else: email_subject = f"⚠️ [ALERT] {a_type} - {a_dev} ({a_net})" # ------------------------------------------------------------------------- # 4.
